record_title: Sharp normalized moment comparison for polynomial zeros and critical points
provenance: A sharp refinement of the normalized zero/critical-point moment comparison in Lemma 2.5 of Teng Zhang, arXiv:2609.20256v1, using the Komarova--Rivin differentiator representation and rank-one cancellation.
limitations: Originality is to the best of our knowledge. The differentiator representation is classical, and an equivalent rank-one-compression trace inequality may exist under different terminology. Equality is established for every fixed moment order along degrees divisible by that order, but no exact extremal value is claimed for every pair (n,m). The analytic-test corollary is not claimed to have the optimal constant for a prescribed test class. No independent validation or formal proof-assistant verification is asserted.
